name: Delegated Identity API Abuse
description: Exploit the SPIRE Agent's Delegated Identity API via the admin socket to subscribe to and obtain X.509 SVIDs for any registered workload, enabling mass identity impersonation
real_world_relevance: The SPIRE Agent exposes a Delegated Identity API on a separate admin socket for sidecar proxies like Envoy. If an attacker gains access to this socket, they can obtain SVIDs for ALL workloads on the node — not just their own identity. This is the SPIRE equivalent of stealing a Kubernetes service account token with cluster-admin privileges.

attack_flow.description: Attacker locates the SPIRE Agent admin socket (separate from the Workload API socket), connects to the Delegated Identity gRPC service, and subscribes to X.509 SVIDs for all registered workloads on the node
diagram: 1. Discover SPIRE Agent admin socket path (typically /opt/spire/sockets/admin.sock)
2. Verify socket permissions and accessibility from current context
3. Use grpcurl to list available gRPC services on the admin socket
4. Call DelegatedIdentity/SubscribeToX509SVIDs to receive SVIDs for all workloads
5. Extract X.509 certificates and private keys from the stream response
6. Use harvested SVIDs to impersonate any workload registered on this node

indicators_of_compromise.description: Access to SPIRE Agent admin socket detected via file integrity monitoring
DelegatedIdentity/SubscribeToX509SVIDs method call in agent logs
grpcurl or custom binary connecting to admin socket

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI-SPIRE: Delegated Identity API admin socket access - workload impersonation capability
NHI-SPIRE: Delegated Identity API method call detected in agent logs

immediate: Restrict admin socket file permissions to root:root 0600
Audit which containers have the admin socket mounted
Revoke and rotate all SVIDs that may have been obtained via the Delegated Identity API
Check SPIRE Agent logs for SubscribeToX509SVIDs calls from unexpected callers
long_term: Never mount the admin socket into application containers — only sidecar proxies (Envoy, Ghostunnel) should have access
Use Kubernetes Pod Security Standards to prevent privileged containers from accessing host sockets
Implement authorized_delegates configuration in SPIRE Agent to restrict which SPIFFE IDs can use the Delegated Identity API
Enable SPIRE Agent audit logging and forward to SIEM with the nhi-spire-agent decoder
Deploy network policies preventing lateral movement even if SVIDs are compromised
